## Features

- **build**: Publish mongosh to RHEL 9/10 PPAs for ppc64le and s390x (MONGOSH-3843, #2920)


## Bug Fixes

- Do not release in EOL repositories (#2922)
- **cli-repl**: Escape ANSI sequences from errors (MONGOSH-3587, #2912)



See an overview of all solved issues [in Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/issues/?jql=project%20%3D%20MONGOSH%20AND%20fixVersion%20%3D%202.14.3)
